_doc: Registered exceptions for the meta self-check (#48, scripts/self_check_docs.py). A document lands here only when it must quote catalogue material in RUNNING PROSE — where the #69 markup pre-pass cannot separate evidence from voice without falsifying the document. Every entry carries a reason and a ceiling pinned to the measured value plus a 0.01 tolerance, and always strictly below 1.0 — a ceiling at the score maximum could never be breached, because classifier scores are capped there; the ceiling is a ratchet, so a registered document that gets worse still fails, and one that becomes clean loses its entry (tests/test_self_check_docs.py enforces both). Same shape and same discipline as eval/fp_baseline.json.
